themes.source: neutral.css owns current light overrides; workbench.css retains dark overrides. Both graph renderer palettes are identical and white. Preferences are under Datasets → Local dataset & appearance.

focus.graphCanvas: var(--graph-focus), retained blue-gray on the white canvas in both appearances
focus.graphNode: Independent selected-color outer ring; keyboard focus strengthens the node ring.
focus.close: Escape and close controls restore focus to the originating control when available.

graph.direction: DOWN / TB; top-to-bottom source order and top/bottom ports
graph.selection: Independent outer ring; category stroke, error, phase dot and divergence retain separate meanings.
graph.grouping: Contiguous recorded intervals open in place; preserve anchor and scale. Opaque headers paint after routes.
graph.wheel: Wheel pans vertically; Shift-wheel horizontally; Ctrl/⌘-wheel zooms at pointer.
graph.provenance: Structural links mean containment; file/observation dependency links and content grouping remain declared heuristics. No inferred agent hierarchy.
graph.exports: Same Drawing on screen/SVG/PNG; PNG bounded to 4096px / 12MP, while SVG retains vector detail.

evidence.identity: Run ID plus exact source idx; display ordinal and playback position stay distinct.
evidence.persistentViews: Manual Diff / Updated File / File Context / Output, Inspector tabs, Terminal/Tests and panel visibility survive playback, seek and resize.
evidence.missing: Specific missing state or Unrecorded / 未记录; recorded zero stays zero; no stale preceding patch.
evidence.limits: No invented per-call duration, attempts, agents/parents, distinct reasoning roles, patch/file versions, Token/cost or test pass rate. File targets and later tests do not establish modification or causality.

source.cascade: styles.css → workbench.css → density.css → hierarchy.css → neutral.css, as imported by main.tsx; effective selector specificity and media queries remain binding.
source.scope: Authorized merge after desktop ship verdict. Historical rail/purple/horizontal/two-row directions are superseded. No new mobile design claim. Existing mark retained; image generation deferred. Historical Taste marketing gate remains OPEN.
source.extractionCheck: Read-only computed-style check of the five source stylesheets on synthetic markup at both desktop sizes and in both appearances; no detector/context rerun or private traces accessed.

narrative.overview:
TrajViz is a desktop Operate interface for reading saved agent traces. White workspaces, near-white headers, fine neutral boundaries and dark text keep recorded evidence easy to scan. Blue-gray selection belongs to the default light appearance; green and red retain outcome and diff meaning.

One working area leads each page. Named disclosures keep secondary detail available, and source identity stays close to the evidence. The default appearance is light; the saved dark appearance remains available, with the graph retaining its white ground and category silhouettes.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous work surfaces with single-pixel boundaries and flat depth.
One static navigation row with the existing monochrome mark and six icon/text destinations.
A vertical source DAG with category silhouettes and in-place content expansion.
Readable recorded code, stable exact source identity and explicit missing-evidence states.

rules.name: The Selection and Outcome Rule
rules.body: Selection marks the current source; it never replaces the source outcome. Keep failure borders, written status and diff signs visible inside selected content.

rules.name: The Evidence Reading Rule
rules.body: Reduce repeated metadata and close secondary detail before reducing evidence type. Long code and logs scroll within their own region.

rules.name: The Workspace Scroll Rule
rules.body: At desktop widths, Graph and Timeline fit the available screen with their inspection and local evidence regions. Replay, Compare, Analytics and Datasets use natural document scrolling.

rules.name: The Stable Source Rule
rules.body: Run ID plus exact source idx identifies selection across views and shared URLs. Display ordinals and playback positions remain distinct from source identity.

dos: Do use the light appearance as the default and preserve the saved dark appearance.
Do keep the graph white and read the source DAG from top to bottom in both appearances.
Do pair semantic color with written status, icons, exit codes or diff signs.
Do preserve exact source identity and every occurrence of a repeated normalized signature.
Do keep manually chosen evidence views and open panels stable during playback, seek and resize.
Do show missing data as Unrecorded / 未记录 or a specific missing-evidence state; a recorded zero stays zero.
Do retain reachable local scrolling, keyboard focus and fullscreen inspection.
donts: Don't restore the historical app rail, purple selection, horizontal DAG or two-row navigation.
Don't add a product name, breadcrumbs, global search, help, notifications or an avatar to the topbar.
Don't represent the existing layers mark as a newly generated logo; generation remains deferred.
Don't invent agent hierarchy, call parents, reasoning roles, durations, attempts, file versions, cost or test pass rates to fill a layout.
Don't treat file targets as proof of modification, timestamp gaps as durations, or alignment matches and later successful tests as causal proof.
Don't use sample metrics, code or reference task names as product evidence, or publish private traces in public assets.
Don't claim a new mobile composition or a pass of the historical marketing-page gate from this desktop revision.
